shock_band: Euclidean distance to domain-clipped exact interior line segment; combined is mask union
shock_band_rmse: sqrt(mean((prediction-reference)^2)) on masked existing Cartesian grid nodes; not relative L2
shock_band_missing: no interior line or empty band -> NaN RMSE and zero count; independent of shock detection
aggregation: each time separately; arc-length midpoint quadrature, combined weighted by line length
prediction: bilinear interpolation of unchanged Cartesian model predictions; no model re-query
position: absolute normal distance to exact line; exact width zero
missing: conditional means; detection and width-valid length fractions reported
